newsitem.title: USA: USX unit to invest $40 million in plate mill.
newsitem.headline: USX unit to invest $40 million in plate mill.

text.p: USX Corp's U.S. Steel Plate Productions division on Monday said it would invest about $40 million to modernize its 160-inch plate mill at the Gary Works.
The investment will improve quality and allow U.S. Steel to produce more products for the high-carbon, alloy and stainless plate markets, the company said.

The company will install new heat-treating equipment to improve surface quality and make Gary's plate products more uniform. The new facilities will be able to treat a minimum of 75,000 tons of plates annually in various widths and thicknesses.
The installation is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 1998.
The company said it would also install a roller support system on the mill's cooling bed. The new system will reduce friction and minimize scratching.
